name: my-ride-nepal-web
description: Laravel API (repo root) and the public website (frontend/). `npm run dev` starts both for local development; the staff portal is the Road-trip-admin repo.

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-ports-free.mjs ${API_PORT:-8010} ${WEB_PORT:-5180} && npx --yes concurrently@10.0.7 --kill-others --names api,queue,logs,web -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#86efac" "php artisan serve --port=${API_PORT:-8010} --tries=1" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1 --timeout=0" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "API_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:${API_PORT:-8010} npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --port ${WEB_PORT:-5180}"
